# Somnus Labs - LLM Context File
# https://www.somnuslabs.com/llms.txt

> Somnus Labs builds AI products that ship faster, learn faster, and stay on-brand.

## Company Overview
Somnus Labs is a software studio founded in 2023. We build and run Deskwork, MagicReply, CMAForge, ARV Analyzer and PlantVision, and we build custom software for clients. We keep a person in the loop where money or reputation is on the line.

## Products

### Deskwork
- URL: https://deskworkapp.com
- App: https://app.deskworkapp.com
- Purpose: One back office for independent real estate brokerages: transactions, documents, deadlines, commissions, payouts and reporting

### MagicReply
- URL: https://magicreply.ai
- App: https://app.magicreply.ai
- Purpose: Drafts a reply to each Google review in your brand voice; you edit it, approve it, and post it to Google

### CMAForge
- URL: https://cmaforge.com
- App: https://app.cmaforge.com
- Purpose: Chat with AI that knows your market: instant CMAs, comps, offer analysis, and client-ready reports for real estate agents

### ARV Analyzer
- URL: https://arvanalyzer.com
- Purpose: AI deal underwriting for real estate investors: ARV, rehab estimate, MAO, deal score, risk flags and exit strategies

### PlantVision
- URL: https://plantvisionapp.com
- Purpose: Identify any plant from a photo in your browser, then ask care questions in the chat

## Client Work
- Dealer assistant: custom messaging assistant built for Deals Unlimited Inc., a used-car dealership. Answers dealership staff questions about warranties and inventory. Not a public product.

## In the Works
- ListingPhoto (listingphoto.net) and ListingReels (listingreels.net): in development, coming soon
- PromptNexus: no-code AI workflows (https://promptnexus.ai)

## Our Philosophy
- Safety and observability built into every product
- Human-in-the-loop where it matters
- Ship fast, learn faster
- Stay on-brand for our customers

## Contact
